face.flavorText: 希奈丝特拉满心恨意，智谋超群。她从地底深处召唤出了黑血，用来变异并强化她的部队。

face.text: Colossal +3. After you restore Health to a character,& attack a random enemy minion.
face.flavorText: As cunning as she is hateful, Sinestra summoned the Black Blood from deep within the earth to mutate and empower her forces.

face.flavorText: 拉格纳罗斯誓要让艾泽拉斯化为火海。他唤醒了一座活火山，熔岩横流，漫过了贫瘠之地。

face.name: Vulcanos
face.text: Colossal +2 At the end of your turn,& deal 3 damage to all other minions.
face.flavorText: Determined to see Azeroth aflame, Ragnaros awakened a living volcano to send rivers of lava across the Barrens.
